Do not change NOT VERIFIED to PARTIAL until a concrete implementation work item/PR has begun; do not change PARTIAL to DONE without workflow, codebase, database and runtime acceptance.

progress_scoring.policy: Do not invent a percentage from a PARTIAL label or historical domain estimate. Each feature must first be decomposed into evidence-backed acceptance criteria.
progress_scoring.calculation: progress_pct = sum of weights for criteria with a passing, linked evidence artifact. Any BLOCKED or SKIPPED acceptance criterion scores 0 for that criterion. DONE requires 100%, no BLOCKED/SKIPPED, and independent review where release policy requires it.
progress_scoring.current_scoring_state: Feature-level percentages are intentionally unscored until each feature has explicit criteria and evidence links; historical_estimate_pct is not a current completion score.
